title: Airboat Adventures
specs: Tours explore 20,000-acre tidewater cypress swamp near Jean Lafitte National Historical Park
Wildlife sightings include alligators, wild boar, birds, turtles, and water snakes
Minimum age 5 years for all airboat products
Pregnant women, children under 5, or anyone with neck/back injuries not allowed on airboats
Must be able to board airboat without assistance
Small airboats seat up to 6 or 10 passengers; large airboats seat up to 30 passengers
Private tours available by calling to arrange

blurb: Guests board airboats to explore a 20,000-acre tidewater cypress swamp near Jean Lafitte National Historical Park. Tours include wildlife viewing such as alligators, wild boar, and birds. Experienced local guides provide commentary and ensure safety.
extraNote: Roundtrip transportation from downtown New Orleans is extra $30 per person · Transportation pickup begins 1 hour 15 minutes before tour time; guests must be waiting outside · Pets and emotional support animals not allowed on airboats; service animals only on pontoon boats with documentation · 5145 Fleming Park Rd, Lafitte, LA 70067
